# Brendon Mapinda — Creative Studio + Automation Lab

> Cape Town–based creative studio and automation lab run by Brendon Mapinda. Two paths, chosen from the landing page: premium photography & content (the Studio), and software & automation (Systems). Brand promise: premium visuals, smart systems, business growth — helping brands look premium and run smarter.

## Site structure

- **Landing** (`/`): a chooser — Photography & Content, or Software & Automation.
- **Studio** (`/studio.html`): photography & video.
- **Systems** (`/systems.html`): AI automation, software & business optimization.

## The Studio (photography & content)

Editorial portraits, brand & venue content (lounges, bars, products, personalities), cinematic short-form reels for Instagram/TikTok, and event coverage (graduations, baby showers, brand activations). Photographer/cinematographer since 2017, with eight years refining a single editorial aesthetic: premium, moody and lifestyle-led, with every photo edited by hand. Photos and reels made for Instagram and WhatsApp, and memories clients can come back to. Paid client work includes Reebok South Africa, GoodHope FM and matric dances, alongside portraits of Miss SA contestants.

Session pricing (South African Rand): Mini R1,000 (1 hour, 1 outfit and 1 location, 20 to 50 edited photos, 1 reel) · Signature R1,500 (most booked, outfit changes or more than one location, 30 to 60 edited photos, at least 1 reel) · Premium Creative R2,000 (everything in Signature, for more than one person, shoots that need lighting, the client's own clips in the reel, or a client directed shoot). Event coverage is quoted on request. Every session includes creative direction, every photo edited by hand, and full quality files on Google Drive. Transport is not included, the client arranges it or it is added to the quote.

## Systems (software & automation)

AI automation and AI agents, custom web app and software builds, business-process optimization, and AI discoverability (structuring products and content to be found and recommended inside ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and AI search). Background as an AI-augmented data & migration engineer; 5+ applications built and deployed.

Pricing (South African Rand, indicative): Website from R2,000, most landing between R2,000 and R6,000 · Custom Build from R5,000, most landing between R5,000 and R12,000 · Automation from R10,000, most landing between R10,000 and R15,000. Every build is scoped to the problem.
